tools.name: get_shipper_notification_template
tools.description: Returns the message Notify Shipper starts with for an open Exception, by its number: the TMS's template for the Exception's type, with the Shipper's reference filled in. Only the template's words. Never a Carrier, a remark, the Exception's cause or any detail of it.

tools.name: get_shipper_view
tools.description: Returns what the Shipper sees of a Transport Order, by its number, and nothing else: the Tracking status (Received, Scheduled, Collected, InTransit or Delivered), the collection and delivery places and the delivery window, the ETA and last update, the progress events, whether a Proof of delivery is available (with its delivery time and condition), the time of the answer, and the Shipper notifications the Planner already sent. Never a Carrier, a Shipment number, an Exception, a remark, who signed, a file, a Consignee or a price.
